author: Milwaukee City Wire
title: Barbara Dittrich shares updates on student outreach and spring election voting
text:
Rep. Barbara Dittrich, who represents Wisconsin’s 99th House district, shared a series of updates on March 24, 2026, via her social media account. The posts included community engagement activities with local students, voting information for constituents, and an announcement about an upcoming district event.
In a post from the afternoon of March 24, Dittrich wrote: “I had a blast last week delivering the newest Wisconsin Blue Books to 4th graders throughout my district! These bright students from Lake Country Classical took a trip to the capitol a few weeks ago and I just had to stop by to give them each their own copy of the Blue Book!” (March 24, 2026).
Later that day, she provided information regarding early voting for an upcoming election: “In-Person Absentee Voting for the April 7th Spring Election starts today. If you would like to vote early or find out more information, you can check out the link below: https://t.co/BOoQzmq0WG” (March 24, 2026).
In another message posted in the evening, Dittrich addressed constituents directly about an event scheduled for the following day: “I’m looking forward to seeing you ladies from the district tomorrow for ‘Lipstick & Liberty’ at Whelan’s in Oconomowoc!” (March 24, 2026).
Barbara Dittrich was elected as a Republican representative in Wisconsin’s State House in 2025. She succeeded Cindi Duchow as representative of the state’s 99th House district.
